test_LabelBinarizer: test the LabelBinarizer class for single-class, two-class, and multi-class label binarization with sparse and dense outputs
test_LabelEncoder: test the LabelEncoder class for fitting, transforming, and inverse-transforming numeric and string label arrays
test_MultiLabelBinarizer: test the MultiLabelBinarizer class for binarizing iterable-of-iterables multi-label data with sparse and dense outputs
test_label_binarize: test the label_binarize function for binary, multiclass, and multilabel binarization with custom class ordering and label values
test_inverse_binarize: test the _inverse_binarize_multiclass and _inverse_binarize_thresholding functions for reconstructing original labels from binarized outputs
